page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.d2s.10xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 40 dedicated vCPUs provided by an Intel Xeon 8163 processor operating at a base frequency of 2.5 GHz. The instance is equipped with 176.0 GB of system memory, yielding approximately 4.4 GB of RAM per virtual core.

A defining characteristic of this instance is its massive local storage capacity, offering 117,574 GB of local HDD storage. This high-density storage configuration is paired with a baseline network bandwidth of 20 Gbps, facilitating high-throughput data transfers. The instance does not include any GPU accelerators.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.d2s.10xlarge offers a high ratio of local storage capacity relative to compute and memory resources, making it a specialized option for storage-intensive deployments. Appropriate workloads include big data analytics frameworks such as MapReduce, Hadoop, or Spark, large-scale log processing, data warehousing, and massive database backups where sequential disk I/O and high storage density are prioritized.
